digest.overview: Big funding and infrastructure plays dominate the short window: Wispr closes a massive voice AI round, Stripe reportedly acquires OpenRouter, Anthropic details EU-compliant text watermarks, and AI formally verifies a complex prime-number theorem for the first time.

top_story.headline: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation, pushing beyond dictation
top_story.summary: Wispr closed $280M bringing total funding past $361M; the voice AI startup is expanding past simple dictation into broader interfaces.
top_story.why_it_matters: Voice interfaces are moving from niche to core product layer at $2B valuation with rapid capital influx.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community mood is upbeat on infrastructure deals and technical milestones like math formalization, with excitement around local model performance and aggregation plays.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic details Claude invisible text watermarks for EU rules
frontier_labs.summary: Anthropic confirms its marking system is a version of the open-source SynthID-Text to comply with Europe's AI transparency requirements.

frontier_labs.headline: OpenAI funds 14 independent projects on Intelligence Age policy
frontier_labs.summary: New policy ideas aim to expand economic opportunity and build societal resilience as AI transforms work and daily life.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: These are two videos of an otter using a laptop on an airplane, generated by AI running entirely on my local computer, one in late 2024, and the other today. The first one took 20 minutes using Allegro, the latest 3 minutes using MiniMax H3, and includes sound.
influencer_takes.context: Demonstrates rapid local video generation progress in under two years

research_radar.headline: AI Used to Verify Toughest Mathematics Proof Yet
research_radar.summary: Axiom Math’s AxiomProver automatically verified the “246 theorem” on prime numbers—the first formal verification of this complex result.

research_radar.headline: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
research_radar.summary: New architecture separates global memory (FFN) for knowledge from multiple reasoners (self-attn) for iterative compositional reasoning.

post_ideas.hook: Stripe buying OpenRouter at $7B+ is the clearest signal yet that model routing is now infrastructure
post_ideas.draft: Stripe reportedly acquiring OpenRouter for over $7B just months after its $1.3B valuation shows how fast the AI gateway layer is consolidating.
post_ideas.why_viral: Directly ties payments giant to AI routing economics with a huge number

post_ideas.hook: Local video gen went from 20 minutes to 3 minutes with sound in under two years
post_ideas.draft: Ethan Mollick just showed an otter on a laptop generated locally: 20 min in late 2024 vs 3 min today with MiniMax H3.
post_ideas.why_viral: Concrete before/after benchmark from a trusted voice on rapid local progress

post_ideas.hook: First AI formal verification of the 246 theorem on primes
post_ideas.draft: AxiomProver just verified a notoriously hard prime-number theorem that humans had only recently proved. Math research just hit a new automation milestone.
post_ideas.why_viral: Specific technical achievement with clear milestone framing
